E8.boundary: The repaired 162-real-dimensional light matter space can be endowed with the auxiliary complex structure to count as 81 complex coordinates, but this requires an independent complex-field/spectator structure and is NOT obtained by projecting the original real E8 adjoint alone. Full E8 covariance is not asserted (only its E6 x SU3 grading centralizer); chiral fermion measure and anomalies remain open.
E8.minimal_real_commutant: End_R(R^2) commuting with order-3 rotation = R[I,J]; symmetric part = R I; no rank-one real symmetric grading projector
E8.original_filter_reality: Fixed-vacuum H_shell=(c M+W C)^2 is Hermitian on V_C but fails to map the compact real V_R into itself whenever cW != 0
E8.real_filter: H_real=lambda[c rho^6 (M tensor I) + W S]^2 with c=15/343
E8.real_kernel_obstruction: (ker P_plus) intersect real grade-plane = {0}, likewise for ker P_minus; selecting only one 81-dimensional complex shell cannot act on a nonzero real adjoint matter vector
E8.repair: S=J_E8 tensor J_aux; S is real symmetric, S^2=M tensor I, commutes with the grading, and flips under CP reflection of J_E8

Spin10.caution: Conjugation by the REAL Gamma_10 has the same adjoint action on Chi as the complex two-tick clock i Gamma_10, but is not the same spinor operator. The doubled structure introduces extra real degrees of freedom and is not a derived physical chiral fermion measure.
Spin10.chirality: Chi=i V, purely imaginary Hermitian involution
Spin10.compact_real_obstruction: Neither complex Weyl-16 projector preserves the 32-real-dimensional Clifford carrier; its image intersects that original real space trivially when considered as a single pure Weyl eigenspace
Spin10.conjugate_Weyl_spaces: ordinary complex conjugation exchanges Chi=+1 and Chi=-1
Spin10.gauge_invariance: V commutes with all 45 Spin10 bivectors
Spin10.repaired_real_involution: S=V tensor J_aux, real symmetric with S^2=I on R^64; commutes with the bivector gauge action
